exampleSentences: Choosing the right data model shaped every later query and scaling decision.
A graph data model fits relationship-heavy problems best.

defCn: 顺序记录所有数据变更日志，用于崩溃恢复、复制与审计，是持久性的基础
defEn: A sequential record of all data changes used for crash recovery, replication, and auditing, forming the basis of durability.
codeExample: WAL: append every change to pg_wal before applying to pages.
exampleSentence: The transaction log let the replica replay every committed change.
exampleSentences: The transaction log let the replica replay every committed change.
Write-ahead logging ensures the log is flushed before data pages.

defCn: 多个节点均可接受写操作并相互同步的复制架构，提升可用性与写入扩展但需处理冲突
defEn: A replication topology where several nodes accept writes and sync with each other, boosting availability but requiring conflict handling.
codeExample: Configure bidirectional replication between two data centers.
exampleSentence: Multi-master replication kept writes working even when one site went down.
exampleSentences: Multi-master replication kept writes working even when one site went down.
Last-write-wins or CRDTs resolve conflicting concurrent updates.

defCn: 数据定义语言，用于定义和修改数据库结构（CREATE、ALTER、DROP 等）
defEn: Data Definition Language: SQL statements such as CREATE, ALTER, and DROP that define and modify database structure.
codeExample: CREATE TABLE users (id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY);
exampleSentence: DDL changes like adding a column should be reviewed like any code change.
exampleSentences: DDL changes like adding a column should be reviewed like any code change.
Running DDL often takes locks that can block concurrent writes.

defCn: 数据操作语言，用于对表中数据进行增删改查（SELECT、INSERT、UPDATE、DELETE）
defEn: Data Manipulation Language: SQL statements like SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE that read and modify data.
exampleSentence: Most application queries are DML against the operational tables.
exampleSentences: Most application queries are DML against the operational tables.
Unlike DDL, DML does not change the schema.

defCn: 数据控制语言，用于管理权限与访问（GRANT、REVOKE）
defEn: Data Control Language: SQL statements such as GRANT and REVOKE that manage privileges and access.
codeExample: GRANT SELECT ON reports TO analyst;
exampleSentence: DCL let the admin grant read-only access to the analytics team.
exampleSentences: DCL let the admin grant read-only access to the analytics team.
Revoking a role promptly is part of good access hygiene.

defCn: 事务控制语言，用于管理事务边界（COMMIT、ROLLBACK、SAVEPOINT）
defEn: Transaction Control Language: SQL statements such as COMMIT, ROLLBACK, and SAVEPOINT that manage transaction boundaries.
codeExample: BEGIN; UPDATE accounts SET balance=balance-10; COMMIT;
exampleSentence: TCL wraps the money transfer so a failure rolls everything back.
exampleSentences: TCL wraps the money transfer so a failure rolls everything back.
A savepoint lets you undo part of a long transaction.

defCn: 兼具关系型 ACID 与 NoSQL 水平扩展能力的新一代数据库类别（如 CockroachDB、TiDB）
defEn: A class of modern databases that combine relational ACID guarantees with the horizontal scalability of NoSQL, such as CockroachDB and TiDB.
codeExample: // TiDB presents a MySQL protocol but scales across many nodes
exampleSentence: NewSQL gave us ACID transactions without giving up elastic scaling.
exampleSentences: NewSQL gave us ACID transactions without giving up elastic scaling.
It bridges the gap between traditional RDBMS and distributed stores.

defCn: 幂等的，重复执行产生相同结果而不会产生额外副作用
defEn: An operation that produces the same result no matter how many times it is applied.
exampleSentence: Making the API idempotent lets clients safely retry failed requests.
exampleSentences: Making the API idempotent lets clients safely retry failed requests.
Idempotency keys prevent duplicate charges when a payment POST is retried.

defCn: 表述性状态转移，一种基于资源的网络 API 架构风格（Representational State Transfer）
defEn: An architectural style for building web services around resources, stateless communication, and standard HTTP methods.
exampleSentence: We built the backend as a stateless REST API consumed by the mobile client.
exampleSentences: We built the backend as a stateless REST API consumed by the mobile client.
A truly RESTful service exposes resources identified by URIs.

defCn: 资源，REST 中由 URI 标识的可被操作的数据实体
defEn: In REST, an entity such as a user or order that is identified by a URI and manipulated via HTTP methods.
exampleSentence: Each REST endpoint should map to a resource rather than an action.
exampleSentences: Each REST endpoint should map to a resource rather than an action.
Design your URIs around nouns that represent resources.

defCn: 无状态的，每次请求都包含处理所需的全部信息，服务端不保留会话状态
defEn: Describes a protocol in which each request from client to server contains all the information needed to understand it, with no stored session state on the server.
codeExample: // every request carries its own auth token
exampleSentence: REST APIs are stateless, so the server does not remember previous requests.
exampleSentences: REST APIs are stateless, so the server does not remember previous requests.
Statelessness makes horizontal scaling much easier.

defCn: 可缓存的，响应可声明是否允许被缓存以提升性能
defEn: Describes a response that may be stored and reused by the client or intermediary to improve performance.
exampleSentence: REST responses should be cacheable to reduce server load.
exampleSentences: REST responses should be cacheable to reduce server load.
Set proper Cache-Control headers so the response becomes cacheable.

defCn: HTTP 方法，用于获取资源，安全且幂等
defEn: An HTTP method that retrieves a representation of a resource; safe and idempotent.
exampleSentence: Use GET to fetch data and never to modify state on the server.
exampleSentences: Use GET to fetch data and never to modify state on the server.
GET requests should be safe, meaning they cause no side effects.

defCn: HTTP 方法，用于创建资源，非幂等
defEn: An HTTP method that creates a new resource or submits data; not idempotent.
exampleSentence: Retrying a POST can create duplicate records, so guard it with an idempotency key.
exampleSentences: Retrying a POST can create duplicate records, so guard it with an idempotency key.
POST is typically used to create a new resource on the server.

defCn: HTTP 方法，用于整体替换资源，幂等
defEn: An HTTP method that replaces a resource entirely with the request payload; idempotent.
exampleSentence: PUT replaces the entire resource, so sending the same body twice yields the same result.
exampleSentences: PUT replaces the entire resource, so sending the same body twice yields the same result.
Unlike POST, PUT is idempotent and safe to retry.

defCn: HTTP 方法，用于对资源做部分更新，通常不保证幂等
defEn: An HTTP method that applies a partial modification to a resource; not necessarily idempotent.
exampleSentence: Use PATCH when you want to update a few fields instead of replacing the whole resource.
exampleSentences: Use PATCH when you want to update a few fields instead of replacing the whole resource.
PATCH is not guaranteed to be idempotent unless the payload is defined that way.

defCn: HTTP 方法，用于删除资源，幂等
defEn: An HTTP method that removes a resource; idempotent.
exampleSentence: Deleting a resource repeatedly is safe because DELETE is idempotent.
exampleSentences: Deleting a resource repeatedly is safe because DELETE is idempotent.
A second DELETE usually returns 404 after the resource is gone.

defCn: 状态码，HTTP 响应中表示请求结果的三位数字
defEn: A three-digit number in an HTTP response indicating the outcome of the request.
exampleSentence: Always return a meaningful status code so clients can handle errors correctly.
exampleSentences: Always return a meaningful status code so clients can handle errors correctly.
The 2xx status codes indicate a successful request.

defCn: 401 未授权，缺少或无效的身份凭证
defEn: An HTTP status indicating that the request lacks valid authentication credentials.
exampleSentence: Return 401 when the request has no valid credentials, and 403 when the user lacks permission.
exampleSentences: Return 401 when the request has no valid credentials, and 403 when the user lacks permission.
A 401 response should include a WWW-Authenticate header.

defCn: 403 禁止，已认证但无权限访问
defEn: An HTTP status indicating the server understood the request but refuses to authorize it.
exampleSentence: The user was logged in, so we returned 403 Forbidden instead of 401.
exampleSentences: The user was logged in, so we returned 403 Forbidden instead of 401.
A 403 means authentication succeeded but authorization failed.

defCn: 404 未找到，请求的资源不存在
defEn: An HTTP status indicating the server cannot find the requested resource.
exampleSentence: When the order id does not exist we respond with 404 Not Found.
exampleSentences: When the order id does not exist we respond with 404 Not Found.
A 404 should not reveal whether the resource is hidden or simply missing.

defCn: 409 冲突，请求与资源当前状态冲突（如重复创建）
defEn: An HTTP status indicating the request conflicts with the current state of the resource.
exampleSentence: We return 409 Conflict when a unique constraint such as email is violated.
exampleSentences: We return 409 Conflict when a unique constraint such as email is violated.
A 409 helps the client understand the request was rejected due to a conflict.

defCn: 422 无法处理的实体，语义错误（如校验失败）
defEn: An HTTP status indicating the server understood the request but it contained semantic errors, such as validation failures.
exampleSentence: When the JSON body fails validation we respond with 422 Unprocessable Entity.
exampleSentences: When the JSON body fails validation we respond with 422 Unprocessable Entity.
422 tells the client the syntax was fine but the semantics were wrong.

defCn: 429 请求过多，触发限流
defEn: An HTTP status indicating the user has sent too many requests in a given amount of time (rate limiting).
exampleSentence: Our gateway returns 429 Too Many Requests when a client exceeds its quota.
exampleSentences: Our gateway returns 429 Too Many Requests when a client exceeds its quota.
Include a Retry-After header with a 429 response.

defCn: 500 内部服务器错误，服务端未捕获的异常
defEn: An HTTP status indicating the server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.
exampleSentence: An unhandled exception in the controller surfaces as a 500 Internal Server Error.
exampleSentences: An unhandled exception in the controller surfaces as a 500 Internal Server Error.
Return a generic 500 to the client and log the stack trace server-side.

defCn: 502 网关错误，上游服务返回无效响应
defEn: An HTTP status indicating a gateway or proxy received an invalid response from an upstream server.
exampleSentence: The load balancer returned 502 Bad Gateway because the backend crashed.
exampleSentences: The load balancer returned 502 Bad Gateway because the backend crashed.
A 502 usually means the upstream service is down or misconfigured.

defCn: 503 服务不可用，临时过载或维护
defEn: An HTTP status indicating the server is temporarily unable to handle the request, often due to overload or maintenance.
exampleSentence: During a deploy we return 503 Service Unavailable with a Retry-After header.
exampleSentences: During a deploy we return 503 Service Unavailable with a Retry-After header.
Clients should back off and retry after a 503.

defCn: JSON Web Token，自包含、带签名的无状态认证令牌（JSON Web Token）
defEn: A compact, URL-safe, signed token that encodes claims and enables stateless authentication.
exampleSentence: We issue a JWT after login so the client can authenticate subsequent requests statelessly.
exampleSentences: We issue a JWT after login so the client can authenticate subsequent requests statelessly.
A JWT has three parts: header, payload, and signature.

defCn: OAuth 2.0，授权框架，允许第三方应用在不暴露凭证的情况下获取有限访问权限
defEn: An authorization framework that lets a third-party application obtain limited access to a user's resources without sharing credentials.
exampleSentence: We integrated 'Login with Google' using the OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow.
exampleSentences: We integrated 'Login with Google' using the OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow.
OAuth 2.0 delegates authorization, not authentication.

defCn: OpenID Connect，构建在 OAuth 2.0 之上的身份验证层
defEn: An identity layer built on top of OAuth 2.0 that authenticates the user and obtains profile information.
exampleSentence: Use OpenID Connect when you need to authenticate users, not just authorize access.
exampleSentences: Use OpenID Connect when you need to authenticate users, not just authorize access.
OpenID Connect adds an ID token to the OAuth 2.0 access token.

defCn: 认证，验证通信方身份（你是谁）
defEn: The process of verifying the identity of a user or client making a request.
exampleSentence: Authentication answers 'who are you', while authorization answers 'what can you do'.
exampleSentences: Authentication answers 'who are you', while authorization answers 'what can you do'.
Passwords, tokens, and biometrics are all forms of authentication.

defCn: 授权，验证已认证身份能执行的操作（你能做什么）
defEn: The process of determining what actions an authenticated principal is permitted to perform.
exampleSentence: After authentication, the middleware checks authorization before allowing the action.
exampleSentences: After authentication, the middleware checks authorization before allowing the action.
Role-based access control is a common authorization model.

defCn: 会话，服务端保存的已登录用户状态
defEn: Server-side state representing a logged-in user, usually referenced by a session id stored in a cookie.
exampleSentence: With session-based auth, the server stores user state and the browser holds only a session id.
exampleSentences: With session-based auth, the server stores user state and the browser holds only a session id.
Sessions make immediate revocation straightforward via the server store.

defCn: Cookie，浏览器存储并在请求中自动携带的小段数据
defEn: A small piece of data stored by the browser and sent with every HTTP request to the same origin.
exampleSentence: We store the session id in a cookie with the HttpOnly flag to keep it away from JavaScript.
exampleSentences: We store the session id in a cookie with the HttpOnly flag to keep it away from JavaScript.
Cookies enable stateful behavior over the stateless HTTP protocol.

defCn: 持有者令牌，持有即代表拥有访问权，常用于 Authorization 头
defEn: A token presented in the Authorization header where possession of the token itself grants access.
exampleSentence: The client sends the bearer token in the Authorization header on every request.
exampleSentences: The client sends the bearer token in the Authorization header on every request.
Anyone holding a bearer token can use it, so always transport it over HTTPS.

defCn: API 密钥，标识并校验调用方身份的长字符串
defEn: A unique secret string that identifies and authenticates a client calling an API.
exampleSentence: Public APIs often require an API key to track and throttle usage per client.
exampleSentences: Public APIs often require an API key to track and throttle usage per client.
Treat an API key like a password and never commit it to source control.

defCn: 跨域资源共享，浏览器限制跨源请求的安全机制（Cross-Origin Resource Sharing）
defEn: A browser security mechanism that controls whether a web page can make requests to a different origin.
exampleSentence: Because the frontend and API run on different domains, we had to configure CORS headers.
exampleSentences: Because the frontend and API run on different domains, we had to configure CORS headers.
CORS is enforced by the browser, not the server.

defCn: 预检请求，浏览器对复杂跨域请求先发的 OPTIONS 探测
defEn: An automatic OPTIONS request the browser sends before a non-simple cross-origin request to check permissions.
exampleSentence: Non-simple requests like PUT trigger a preflight request before the real call.
exampleSentences: Non-simple requests like PUT trigger a preflight request before the real call.
The preflight request uses the OPTIONS method and checks allowed headers.

defCn: 超文本传输安全协议，基于 TLS/SSL 加密的 HTTP
defEn: HTTP secured with TLS/SSL encryption, providing confidentiality, integrity, and authentication.
exampleSentence: Always serve APIs over HTTPS to protect credentials and tokens in transit.
exampleSentences: Always serve APIs over HTTPS to protect credentials and tokens in transit.
Browsers now mark plain HTTP sites as insecure.

defCn: TLS 握手，协商加密套件与密钥、校验证书的过程
defEn: The negotiation process where client and server agree on ciphers, exchange certificates, and derive session keys.
exampleSentence: The TLS handshake establishes the encrypted channel before any HTTP data is sent.
exampleSentences: The TLS handshake establishes the encrypted channel before any HTTP data is sent.
A slow TLS handshake adds latency to the first request.

defCn: 跨站脚本攻击，向页面注入恶意脚本（Cross-Site Scripting）
defEn: A vulnerability where an attacker injects malicious scripts into web pages viewed by other users.
exampleSentence: Escaping user input prevents XSS by stopping injected scripts from executing.
exampleSentences: Escaping user input prevents XSS by stopping injected scripts from executing.
Content Security Policy headers mitigate the impact of XSS.

defCn: 跨站请求伪造，诱骗已认证用户的浏览器发出非本意请求（Cross-Site Request Forgery）
defEn: An attack that tricks a victim's browser into issuing unauthorized requests using their authenticated session.
exampleSentence: We defend against CSRF using SameSite cookies and anti-forgery tokens.
exampleSentences: We defend against CSRF using SameSite cookies and anti-forgery tokens.
CSRF exploits the browser's automatic inclusion of cookies.

defCn: SameSite，控制 Cookie 是否随跨站请求发送，用于缓解 CSRF
defEn: A cookie attribute that restricts whether the browser sends the cookie along with cross-site requests.
exampleSentence: Setting SameSite=Strict prevents the cookie from being sent on cross-site requests, mitigating CSRF.
exampleSentences: Setting SameSite=Strict prevents the cookie from being sent on cross-site requests, mitigating CSRF.
SameSite=None requires the Secure flag to work over HTTPS.

defCn: HttpOnly，禁止 JavaScript 读取 Cookie，缓解 XSS 窃取
defEn: A cookie flag that prevents client-side scripts from accessing the cookie, defending against XSS theft.
exampleSentence: Marking the session cookie HttpOnly keeps it out of reach of malicious JavaScript.
exampleSentences: Marking the session cookie HttpOnly keeps it out of reach of malicious JavaScript.
HttpOnly cookies can only be sent in HTTP requests, not read by document.cookie.

defCn: HTTP 严格传输安全，强制浏览器只用 HTTPS 访问域名
defEn: A policy mechanism that tells browsers to interact with a domain only over HTTPS, preventing downgrade attacks.
exampleSentence: Enabling HSTS stops attackers from downgrading a connection to plain HTTP.
exampleSentences: Enabling HSTS stops attackers from downgrading a connection to plain HTTP.
HSTS protects users from SSL-stripping attacks on the first request.

defCn: 域名系统，将域名解析为 IP 地址（Domain Name System）
defEn: The system that translates human-readable domain names into IP addresses.
exampleSentence: Before connecting, the browser performs a DNS lookup to find the server's IP address.
exampleSentences: Before connecting, the browser performs a DNS lookup to find the server's IP address.
DNS results are cached according to their TTL.

defCn: 传输控制协议，面向连接、可靠、有序的传输层协议
defEn: A connection-oriented, reliable transport protocol that guarantees ordered, error-checked delivery.
codeExample: TCP three-way handshake: SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK
exampleSentence: HTTP runs on top of TCP, which guarantees that packets arrive in order.
exampleSentences: HTTP runs on top of TCP, which guarantees that packets arrive in order.
TCP's reliability comes at the cost of higher overhead than UDP.

defCn: 用户数据报协议，无连接、更快但不保证可靠送达
defEn: A connectionless transport protocol that is faster but offers no delivery or ordering guarantees.
codeExample: DNS queries and video calls often use UDP
exampleSentence: UDP is preferred for live video because speed matters more than perfect reliability.
exampleSentences: UDP is preferred for live video because speed matters more than perfect reliability.
QUIC runs HTTP/3 over UDP to combine speed with reliability.

defCn: WebSocket，全双工、长连接的实时通信协议
defEn: A protocol providing a persistent, full-duplex communication channel over a single TCP connection.
exampleSentence: We use a WebSocket to push live chat messages to clients instantly.
exampleSentences: We use a WebSocket to push live chat messages to clients instantly.
Unlike HTTP polling, a WebSocket stays open and can send data both ways.

defCn: 游标分页，基于上一页末尾指针的稳定分页方式
defEn: A pagination strategy that uses an opaque pointer to the last item, giving stable results as data changes.
exampleSentence: Cursor pagination avoids skipping or duplicating rows when new data is inserted.
exampleSentences: Cursor pagination avoids skipping or duplicating rows when new data is inserted.
Unlike offset pagination, cursor pagination performs consistently at deep pages.

defCn: 幂等键，客户端发送的唯一标识，使重复请求被安全去重
defEn: A unique client-supplied value that lets the server deduplicate retried requests safely.
exampleSentence: We attach an idempotency key to payment requests so retries never double-charge.
exampleSentences: We attach an idempotency key to payment requests so retries never double-charge.
The server stores the key and returns the original response on a replayed request.

defCn: 访问令牌，用于访问受保护资源的短期凭证
defEn: A short-lived credential that authorizes access to protected resources.
exampleSentence: The access token expires in an hour, after which the client must refresh it.
exampleSentences: The access token expires in an hour, after which the client must refresh it.
Access tokens should have a short lifetime to limit the blast radius of leaks.

defCn: 刷新令牌，用于换取新的访问令牌的长期凭证
defEn: A long-lived credential used to obtain a new access token without re-authenticating.
exampleSentence: We keep the refresh token in secure storage and use it to mint new access tokens.
exampleSentences: We keep the refresh token in secure storage and use it to mint new access tokens.
Refresh tokens should be revocable and rotated on each use.

defCn: QUIC，基于 UDP 的新一代传输协议，HTTP/3 的底层
defEn: A modern transport protocol over UDP that powers HTTP/3 with faster connection setup and connection migration.
codeExample: HTTP/3 runs on QUIC instead of TCP
exampleSentence: Because QUIC runs over UDP, it avoids head-of-line blocking and speeds up recovery.
exampleSentences: Because QUIC runs over UDP, it avoids head-of-line blocking and speeds up recovery.
QUIC supports 0-RTT resumption, reducing latency on repeat connections.

defCn: Webhook，服务端在有事件时主动回调客户端提供的 URL
defEn: A user-defined HTTP callback that a server invokes to push event notifications to a client.
exampleSentence: Instead of polling, we register a webhook so Stripe notifies us when a payment succeeds.
exampleSentences: Instead of polling, we register a webhook so Stripe notifies us when a payment succeeds.
Webhooks should be verified with a signature to prevent spoofed events.

defCn: 端点，API 中一个可被访问的 URL 入口
defEn: A specific URL in an API that accepts requests and returns responses for a resource or action.
exampleSentence: Each endpoint should document its method, parameters, and possible status codes.
exampleSentences: Each endpoint should document its method, parameters, and possible status codes.
We versioned the endpoint under /v1 to keep old clients working.

defCn: API 版本控制，在不破坏旧客户端的前提下演进接口
defEn: The practice of evolving an API while keeping backward compatibility, often via URI or header versioning.
exampleSentence: We introduced API versioning so breaking changes go into /v2 without breaking /v1 clients.
exampleSentences: We introduced API versioning so breaking changes go into /v2 without breaking /v1 clients.
URI versioning is simpler, while header versioning keeps URLs clean.

defCn: PKCE，OAuth 中用于公开客户端的授权码增强安全机制（Proof Key for Code Exchange）
defEn: An OAuth 2.0 extension that protects the authorization code flow in public clients against interception.
exampleSentence: Mobile apps must use the authorization code flow with PKCE to stay secure.
exampleSentences: Mobile apps must use the authorization code flow with PKCE to stay secure.
PKCE proves the client that exchanges the code is the same one that started login.

defCn: 编排：自动调度、协调与管理大量容器或服务的部署、网络与生命周期
defEn: The automated arrangement, coordination, and management of complex container deployments.
exampleSentence: Kubernetes handles orchestration of hundreds of microservices across the cluster.
exampleSentences: Kubernetes handles orchestration of hundreds of microservices across the cluster.
Orchestration differs from simple scheduling by managing the full application lifecycle.

defCn: 容器：把应用代码、依赖与运行环境打包成可移植、轻量、隔离的运行单元
defEn: A lightweight, portable, isolated runtime unit that packages application code with its dependencies.
exampleSentence: A container shares the host kernel and starts in seconds, unlike a full virtual machine.
exampleSentences: A container shares the host kernel and starts in seconds, unlike a full virtual machine.
We packaged the service into a container so it runs identically in CI and production.

defCn: 容器镜像：只读模板，包含运行容器所需的文件系统与配置，是容器的静态来源
defEn: An immutable, read-only template containing the filesystem and configuration needed to run a container.
exampleSentence: The container image is built once and promoted unchanged through every environment.
exampleSentences: The container image is built once and promoted unchanged through every environment.
We scan every container image for vulnerabilities before it reaches the registry.

defCn: Dockerfile：定义如何构建容器镜像的文本脚本，包含基础镜像、指令与层
defEn: A text script that defines the steps to build a container image, layer by layer.
exampleSentence: A multi-stage Dockerfile keeps the final image small by discarding build tooling.
exampleSentences: A multi-stage Dockerfile keeps the final image small by discarding build tooling.
We cache layers carefully by ordering the Dockerfile instructions from least to most frequently changed.

defCn: Pod：Kubernetes 中最小的可部署单元，包含一个或多个共享网络与存储的容器
defEn: The smallest deployable unit in Kubernetes, grouping one or more containers that share network and storage.
exampleSentence: A pod is the scheduling unit that binds tightly coupled containers together.
exampleSentences: A pod is the scheduling unit that binds tightly coupled containers together.
The pod crashed because its liveness probe kept failing on the main container.

defCn: Deployment：Kubernetes 工作负载对象，声明式管理 Pod 副本数与滚动更新
defEn: A Kubernetes workload object that declaratively manages replica counts and rolling updates of pods.
exampleSentence: The deployment ensures three replicas are always running and healthy.
exampleSentences: The deployment ensures three replicas are always running and healthy.
A failed deployment automatically rolls back to the previous stable revision.

defCn: Service：Kubernetes 中提供稳定网络端点、对一组 Pod 进行负载均衡的抽象
defEn: A Kubernetes abstraction that provides a stable network endpoint and load balances traffic to a set of pods.
exampleSentence: A ClusterIP service keeps internal traffic inside the cluster without exposing it externally.
exampleSentences: A ClusterIP service keeps internal traffic inside the cluster without exposing it externally.
The service routes requests to whichever pods are currently ready.

defCn: ReplicaSet：保证指定数量 Pod 副本持续运行的 Kubernetes 控制器
defEn: A Kubernetes controller that maintains a specified number of pod replicas running at all times.
exampleSentence: The ReplicaSet recreates pods that crash so the desired count is always met.
exampleSentences: The ReplicaSet recreates pods that crash so the desired count is always met.
Deployments manage ReplicaSets, which in turn manage the actual pods.

defCn: StatefulSet：用于有状态工作负载的控制器，提供稳定网络标识与持久存储
defEn: A Kubernetes controller for stateful workloads, providing stable identities and persistent storage.
exampleSentence: We use a StatefulSet for the database because each replica needs a stable hostname and volume.
exampleSentences: We use a StatefulSet for the database because each replica needs a stable hostname and volume.
Unlike a Deployment, a StatefulSet rolls out pods in order with predictable names.

defCn: ConfigMap：存储非机密配置数据（键值对），可注入 Pod 作为环境变量或文件
defEn: A Kubernetes object that stores non-confidential configuration data as key-value pairs for pods.
exampleSentence: We mount the ConfigMap to keep application settings separate from the container image.
exampleSentences: We mount the ConfigMap to keep application settings separate from the container image.
Updating a ConfigMap can trigger a rolling restart without rebuilding the image.

defCn: Secret：Kubernetes 中用于存储密码、令牌、密钥等敏感数据的对象
defEn: A Kubernetes object for storing sensitive data such as passwords, tokens, and keys.
exampleSentence: Credentials should live in a Secret, never hardcoded inside the container image.
exampleSentences: Credentials should live in a Secret, never hardcoded inside the container image.
We inject the database password from a Secret at runtime rather than baking it in.

defCn: Ingress：管理集群外部访问服务的路由规则（如基于主机名或路径的 HTTP 路由）
defEn: Kubernetes routing rules that control external access to services, typically via HTTP host or path.
exampleSentence: The Ingress routes api.example.com to the API service and web.example.com to the frontend.
exampleSentences: The Ingress routes api.example.com to the API service and web.example.com to the frontend.
An Ingress controller implements the rules defined in the Ingress object.

defCn: 命名空间：在集群内做资源逻辑隔离与多租户划分的虚拟分区
defEn: A virtual partition that logically isolates and groups resources within a Kubernetes cluster.
exampleSentence: We deploy each team's workloads into its own namespace for isolation and access control.
exampleSentences: We deploy each team's workloads into its own namespace for isolation and access control.
Resource quotas per namespace prevent one team from consuming the whole cluster.

defCn: 存活探针：检测容器是否仍在运行，失败时由 kubelet 重启该容器
defEn: A health check that determines whether a container is running; failure triggers a restart.
exampleSentence: A misconfigured liveness probe can cause a CrashLoopBackOff by restarting a slow but healthy container.
exampleSentences: A misconfigured liveness probe can cause a CrashLoopBackOff by restarting a slow but healthy container.
The liveness probe restarts the container only when the app is truly dead.

defCn: 就绪探针：检测容器是否已准备好接收流量，未就绪则从 Service 负载均衡中摘除
defEn: A health check that determines whether a container is ready to receive traffic.
exampleSentence: The readiness probe keeps a pod out of the load balancer until it has warmed up its cache.
exampleSentences: The readiness probe keeps a pod out of the load balancer until it has warmed up its cache.
Liveness and readiness probes serve different purposes: restart versus traffic admission.

defCn: 水平 Pod 自动扩缩器（HPA）：依据 CPU、内存或自定义指标自动调整 Pod 副本数
defEn: A Kubernetes component that automatically adjusts pod replica counts based on metrics.
exampleSentence: The Horizontal Pod Autoscaler adds replicas when CPU utilization crosses the target.
exampleSentences: The Horizontal Pod Autoscaler adds replicas when CPU utilization crosses the target.
HPA scales the number of pods, while the cluster autoscaler scales the nodes underneath.

defCn: 自愈：编排系统自动重启失败实例、替换节点、重新调度以维持期望状态的能力
defEn: The ability of an orchestration system to automatically restart, replace, or reschedule failed instances.
codeExample: kubectl describe pod api-7d9c | grep Restart
exampleSentence: Self-healing keeps the service available by rescheduling crashed pods onto healthy nodes.
exampleSentences: Self-healing keeps the service available by rescheduling crashed pods onto healthy nodes.
Kubernetes continuously reconciles actual state toward the desired state to achieve self-healing.

defCn: 滚动更新：逐步用新版本 Pod 替换旧版本，保证更新期间服务不中断
defEn: A deployment strategy that gradually replaces old pods with new ones without downtime.
exampleSentence: A rolling update lets us ship a new release while keeping the service available throughout.
exampleSentences: A rolling update lets us ship a new release while keeping the service available throughout.
We tune maxSurge and maxUnavailable to control the pace of the rolling update.

defCn: 蓝绿部署：同时运行两套环境，切换流量即可瞬时回滚的零停机发布策略
defEn: A release strategy running two identical environments and switching traffic for instant rollback.
exampleSentence: Blue-green deployment gives us instant rollback by pointing traffic back to the blue stack.
exampleSentences: Blue-green deployment gives us instant rollback by pointing traffic back to the blue stack.
The downside of blue-green deployment is the doubled resource cost during the cutover.

defCn: 金丝雀部署：先把新版本放给少量用户，指标健康后再逐步放量
defEn: A release strategy that exposes a new version to a small subset of users before full rollout.
exampleSentence: We used a canary deployment to limit blast radius when shipping a risky change.
exampleSentences: We used a canary deployment to limit blast radius when shipping a risky change.
If error rate spikes during the canary, we abort and route all traffic back to stable.

defCn: 持续集成与持续交付/部署：自动化构建、测试、发布软件的工程实践
defEn: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery/Deployment: automating build, test, and release.
codeExample: git push → CI builds → CD deploys to prod
exampleSentence: A solid CI/CD pipeline turns every commit into a tested, deployable artifact automatically.
exampleSentences: A solid CI/CD pipeline turns every commit into a tested, deployable artifact automatically.
Continuous delivery stops before production, while continuous deployment ships on every green build.

defCn: 流水线：把构建、测试、扫描、部署等阶段串联起来的自动化交付通道
defEn: An automated sequence of build, test, scan, and deploy stages for software delivery.
exampleSentence: The pipeline failed at the security scan stage, blocking the release to production.
exampleSentences: The pipeline failed at the security scan stage, blocking the release to production.
Each stage in the pipeline must be fast and idempotent to support frequent deliveries.

defCn: GitOps：以 Git 仓库作为系统期望状态的唯一可信源，自动持续校准集群
defEn: An operational model where Git is the single source of truth, with continuous reconciliation.
exampleSentence: With GitOps, a pull request to the manifests repo becomes the trigger for a production change.
exampleSentences: With GitOps, a pull request to the manifests repo becomes the trigger for a production change.
ArgoCD watches Git and reconciles the cluster whenever the declared state drifts.

defCn: 基础设施即代码（IaC）：用声明式配置文件管理服务器、网络等基础设施
defEn: Managing infrastructure such as servers and networks through declarative configuration files.
exampleSentence: Infrastructure as code lets us recreate the whole environment from a Git repository.
exampleSentences: Infrastructure as code lets us recreate the whole environment from a Git repository.
Because our network is defined as code, changes go through the same review process as application code.

defCn: Terraform：主流的基础设施即代码工具，以声明式 HCL 管理多云资源
defEn: A popular infrastructure-as-code tool that manages multi-cloud resources with declarative HCL.
exampleSentence: Terraform keeps a state file so it knows what infrastructure already exists.
exampleSentences: Terraform keeps a state file so it knows what infrastructure already exists.
We store remote Terraform state with locking to let the whole team apply changes safely.

defCn: Ansible：基于 SSH 的无代理配置管理工具，用于批量自动化运维任务
defEn: An agentless configuration-management tool that automates operations over SSH.
exampleSentence: Ansible playbooks are idempotent, so rerunning them converges the host to the same state.
exampleSentences: Ansible playbooks are idempotent, so rerunning them converges the host to the same state.
We use Ansible for configuration management and Terraform for provisioning the base resources.

defCn: 基础设施漂移：实际环境偏离代码中声明的期望状态（常因手工改动产生）
defEn: The divergence between actual infrastructure and the state declared in code.
codeExample: terraform plan  # shows drift vs. real resources
exampleSentence: Manual console changes caused infrastructure drift that the next apply would silently undo.
exampleSentences: Manual console changes caused infrastructure drift that the next apply would silently undo.
GitOps reconciliation detects and corrects infrastructure drift automatically.

defCn: 不可变基础设施：服务器一旦部署就不再修改，变更通过替换新实例完成
defEn: An approach where servers are never modified after deployment; changes replace instances.
exampleSentence: Immutable infrastructure avoids configuration drift by always replacing rather than patching.
exampleSentences: Immutable infrastructure avoids configuration drift by always replacing rather than patching.
Combined with containers, immutable infrastructure makes rollbacks as simple as reverting a tag.

defCn: 监控：持续采集已知信号（指标、仪表盘、告警）以掌握系统运行状态
defEn: Continuously collecting known signals such as metrics, dashboards, and alerts.
exampleSentence: Monitoring focuses on known failure modes through dashboards and threshold alerts.
exampleSentences: Monitoring focuses on known failure modes through dashboards and threshold alerts.
Good monitoring catches the symptoms we already anticipate, while observability covers the rest.

defCn: 指标：可聚合的数值型遥测数据，如请求数、延迟、CPU 使用率
defEn: A numeric, aggregatable telemetry signal such as request count, latency, or CPU usage.
exampleSentence: The RED metrics—rate, errors, and duration—summarize a service's health well.
exampleSentences: The RED metrics—rate, errors, and duration—summarize a service's health well.
A metric is cheap to store because it is just a number with labels over time.

defCn: 日志：系统运行时按时间顺序产生的结构化或半结构化文本事件记录
defEn: A time-ordered, structured or semi-structured text record of events emitted by a system.
exampleSentence: The error log pointed to a null pointer exception right before the outage began.
exampleSentences: The error log pointed to a null pointer exception right before the outage began.
Centralized logging lets us search across thousands of containers from one place.

defCn: 分布式追踪：在微服务调用链中串联请求，定位跨服务延迟与瓶颈
defEn: Following a request across microservice boundaries to locate latency and bottlenecks.
exampleSentence: Distributed tracing revealed the slowdown was in the payment service, not the gateway.
exampleSentences: Distributed tracing revealed the slowdown was in the payment service, not the gateway.
Tracing propagates a context header so each span links into one end-to-end request.

defCn: 追踪：一次请求在系统中流转的完整记录，由多个 span（跨度）组成
defEn: A complete record of a single request's journey through a system, composed of spans.
exampleSentence: A single trace showed the request spent 800ms waiting on a downstream database call.
exampleSentences: A single trace showed the request spent 800ms waiting on a downstream database call.
Each span in a trace captures one operation, its duration, and its parent.

defCn: Prometheus：主流开源监控系统，以拉取方式采集时序指标并支持 PromQL 查询
defEn: A leading open-source monitoring system that scrapes time-series metrics and supports PromQL.
exampleSentence: Prometheus scrapes metrics from each pod every 15 seconds over HTTP.
exampleSentences: Prometheus scrapes metrics from each pod every 15 seconds over HTTP.
We write alerting rules in PromQL so Prometheus can fire alerts on its own.

defCn: Grafana：开源可视化与仪表盘平台，常配合 Prometheus 展示监控数据
defEn: An open-source dashboard and visualization platform, often paired with Prometheus.
exampleSentence: The on-call engineer watches the Grafana dashboard to spot anomalies in real time.
exampleSentences: The on-call engineer watches the Grafana dashboard to spot anomalies in real time.
Grafana queries multiple data sources, not just Prometheus, from one unified view.

defCn: Alertmanager：Prometheus 的告警组件，负责分组、去重、静默与路由通知
defEn: Prometheus's alerting component that groups, deduplicates, silences, and routes notifications.
exampleSentence: Alertmanager dedups flapping alerts so the on-call does not get paged repeatedly.
exampleSentences: Alertmanager dedups flapping alerts so the on-call does not get paged repeatedly.
We silence known alerts during planned maintenance via Alertmanager.

defCn: 服务级别指标（SLI）：衡量系统用户可感知健康状况的具体量化指标
defEn: A Service Level Indicator: a specific, quantifiable measure of user-visible health.
exampleSentence: Our primary SLI is the percentage of checkout requests that succeed within 300ms.
exampleSentences: Our primary SLI is the percentage of checkout requests that succeed within 300ms.
An SLI should reflect what users actually experience, not internal trivia.

defCn: 服务级别协议（SLA）：面向客户、常带违约赔偿的正式可靠性承诺
defEn: A Service Level Agreement: a formal, often contractual reliability promise with penalties.
codeExample: SLA: 99.95% uptime or service credit issued
exampleSentence: The SLA with our customer promises 99.95% uptime and credits if we miss it.
exampleSentences: The SLA with our customer promises 99.95% uptime and credits if we miss it.
An SLO is internal and aspirational; an SLA is external and contractual.

defCn: 错误预算：SLO 允许的不可靠额度（1−SLO），用于权衡发布速度与稳定性
defEn: The allowed unreliability (1 minus SLO) that balances release speed against stability.
exampleSentence: When we burn the error budget too fast, we slow down releases until it recovers.
exampleSentences: When we burn the error budget too fast, we slow down releases until it recovers.
The error budget turns reliability into a number the whole team can reason about.

defCn: 服务网格：处理服务间通信的基础设施层，提供流量管理、mTLS 与遥测
defEn: A dedicated infrastructure layer for service-to-service communication, security, and telemetry.
exampleSentence: A service mesh moves retry and TLS logic out of the application into a sidecar.
exampleSentences: A service mesh moves retry and TLS logic out of the application into a sidecar.
Istio and Linkerd are popular service mesh implementations with different trade-offs.

defCn: 边车：与主容器同 Pod 部署的辅助容器，代理流量或提供日志/监控能力
defEn: A helper container deployed alongside the main container in a pod to proxy or augment it.
exampleSentence: The Envoy sidecar intercepts all traffic so the mesh can enforce policies transparently.
exampleSentences: The Envoy sidecar intercepts all traffic so the mesh can enforce policies transparently.
A sidecar pattern keeps cross-cutting concerns out of the application code.

defCn: 双向 TLS（mTLS）：通信双方互相验证证书，对服务间流量加密并鉴权
defEn: Mutual TLS: both peers authenticate each other's certificates, encrypting and authorizing traffic.
exampleSentence: The mesh enforces mutual TLS so no service can talk to another without a valid identity.
exampleSentences: The mesh enforces mutual TLS so no service can talk to another without a valid identity.
Mutual TLS removes the need to manage secrets for service-to-service auth.

defCn: OpenTelemetry：厂商中立的可观测性数据采集标准与 SDK，统一指标、日志、追踪
defEn: A vendor-neutral standard and SDK for collecting metrics, logs, and traces uniformly.
exampleSentence: We instrument with OpenTelemetry so we can swap backends without rewriting code.
exampleSentences: We instrument with OpenTelemetry so we can swap backends without rewriting code.
OpenTelemetry standardizes tracing context propagation across languages and services.

defCn: Jaeger：开源分布式追踪系统，用于可视化请求调用链、定位延迟热点
defEn: An open-source distributed tracing system for visualizing call chains and latency hotspots.
exampleSentence: Jaeger showed the trace fanning out to five services, with one dominating the latency.
exampleSentences: Jaeger showed the trace fanning out to five services, with one dominating the latency.
We pipe OpenTelemetry spans into Jaeger for end-to-end request views.

defCn: 集中式日志：把分散在各容器/主机的日志统一采集、存储与检索的方案
defEn: Aggregating logs from many hosts or containers into one searchable store.
exampleSentence: Centralized logging let us search every container's output from a single Kibana view.
exampleSentences: Centralized logging let us search every container's output from a single Kibana view.
Without centralized logging, debugging a crashed pod means ssh-ing to random nodes.

defCn: 多阶段构建：在一个 Dockerfile 中用多个阶段分离编译与运行时，缩小最终镜像
defEn: A Dockerfile technique using separate stages to split build and runtime, shrinking the image.
codeExample: FROM golang AS build; FROM alpine AS runtime
exampleSentence: A multi-stage build dropped our image from 900MB to under 30MB.
exampleSentences: A multi-stage build dropped our image from 900MB to under 30MB.
We copy only the compiled binary into the final stage to keep it minimal.

defCn: 基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）：按角色绑定权限，最小授权地管理对资源的访问
defEn: Role-Based Access Control: granting permissions through roles bound to subjects.
exampleSentence: Kubernetes RBAC ensures a developer can only read, never delete, production namespaces.
exampleSentences: Kubernetes RBAC ensures a developer can only read, never delete, production namespaces.
We follow least privilege by scoping each RBAC role to the narrowest needed verbs.

defCn: 密钥管理器：集中保管、加密与自动轮换密钥的托管服务（如 Vault、KMS）
defEn: A managed service that stores, encrypts, and rotates secrets such as Vault or KMS.
exampleSentence: A secret manager issues short-lived tokens so credentials are never static.
exampleSentences: A secret manager issues short-lived tokens so credentials are never static.
We pull database passwords from the secret manager at runtime, not from the repo.

defCn: 混沌工程：在生产中受控注入故障，验证系统韧性并暴露隐藏弱点的实践
defEn: Deliberately injecting controlled failures in production to validate resilience.
exampleSentence: Chaos engineering proved our service survived a random pod kill without user impact.
exampleSentences: Chaos engineering proved our service survived a random pod kill without user impact.
We scope each chaos experiment narrowly to limit the blast radius.

defCn: 事后复盘：故障后无指责地记录时间线、根因与改进项的文档
defEn: A blameless document written after an incident recording timeline, root cause, and fixes.
exampleSentence: The post-mortem found the outage came from a missing health check, not bad code.
exampleSentences: The post-mortem found the outage came from a missing health check, not bad code.
A good post-mortem turns every incident into a concrete, tracked improvement.

defCn: 事件响应：检测、缓解、诊断与沟通生产事故并恢复服务的标准化流程
defEn: The standardized process of detecting, mitigating, diagnosing, and recovering from incidents.
exampleSentence: Clear incident response steps cut our mean time to recovery from hours to minutes.
exampleSentences: Clear incident response steps cut our mean time to recovery from hours to minutes.
During incident response, mitigation comes before root-cause analysis.

defCn: Helm Chart：Kubernetes 应用的打包格式，用模板与值文件描述可复用部署
defEn: A packaging format for Kubernetes applications using templates and value files.
exampleSentence: We version our Helm chart so promoting to production is a single parameterized install.
exampleSentences: We version our Helm chart so promoting to production is a single parameterized install.
Helm charts let teams share a standardized, reusable deployment definition.

defCn: 单元测试，针对最小可测单元（通常是一个函数或类）验证其行为的测试
defEn: A test that verifies the behavior of the smallest testable unit, usually a single function or class.
exampleSentence: A unit test runs in milliseconds and never touches the network.
exampleSentences: A unit test runs in milliseconds and never touches the network.
Every bug fix should ship with a unit test that reproduces it.

defCn: 集成测试，验证多个组件（如服务与数据库）协同工作是否正确的测试
defEn: A test that verifies several components, such as a service and its database, work together correctly.
exampleSentence: The integration test boots a real database container to catch SQL errors.
exampleSentences: The integration test boots a real database container to catch SQL errors.
Integration tests are slower, so teams run them less often than unit tests.

defCn: 回归测试，在修改代码后重新运行既有测试，确认未破坏原有功能
defEn: A test run after a code change to confirm previously working behavior has not broken.
codeExample: mvn test  // reruns the regression suite
exampleSentence: A regression test caught the bug before it reached production.
exampleSentences: A regression test caught the bug before it reached production.
Automated regression tests make refactoring safe.

defCn: 测试覆盖率，被自动化测试执行到的代码比例
defEn: The proportion of source code exercised by automated tests.
exampleSentence: High test coverage does not guarantee the assertions are meaningful.
exampleSentences: High test coverage does not guarantee the assertions are meaningful.
We track test coverage per module rather than one global number.

defCn: 模拟对象，在测试中替代真实依赖并记录交互行为的对象
defEn: A test double that replaces a real dependency and records how it was called.
exampleSentence: We mock the payment client so the test never charges a card.
exampleSentences: We mock the payment client so the test never charges a card.
Overusing mocks makes tests brittle to harmless refactors.

defCn: 断言，测试中声明「结果必须满足条件」的语句
defEn: A statement in a test declaring that a result must satisfy a condition.
exampleSentence: A test without a meaningful assertion proves nothing.
exampleSentences: A test without a meaningful assertion proves nothing.
The assertion message should explain what went wrong.

defCn: 重构，在不改变外部行为的前提下改善代码内部结构
defEn: To restructure existing code without changing its external behavior.
exampleSentence: Refactor only with tests in place, otherwise you cannot prove behavior is unchanged.
exampleSentences: Refactor only with tests in place, otherwise you cannot prove behavior is unchanged.
Small refactors reviewed daily beat one giant rewrite.

defCn: 代码异味，暗示设计存在更深问题的表面征兆（如过长方法、重复代码）
defEn: A surface symptom in code that hints at a deeper design problem, such as a long method or duplication.
codeExample: // a 500-line method is a classic code smell
exampleSentence: Duplicated logic is a code smell that often precedes a real bug.
exampleSentences: Duplicated logic is a code smell that often precedes a real bug.
Code smells are hints, not proofs; always confirm before refactoring.

defCn: 技术债，为求速度而采用次优方案所积累的未来返工成本
defEn: The future rework cost incurred by choosing a quicker but suboptimal solution now.
exampleSentence: Shipping the shortcut created technical debt we paid off two sprints later.
exampleSentences: Shipping the shortcut created technical debt we paid off two sprints later.
Not all technical debt is bad; deliberate debt can fund learning.

defCn: 耦合，模块之间相互依赖的程度，越低越易于独立修改
defEn: The degree to which modules depend on each other; lower coupling makes change easier.
codeExample: // depend on an interface, not a concrete class
exampleSentence: Tight coupling meant one change broke three unrelated services.
exampleSentences: Tight coupling meant one change broke three unrelated services.
Loose coupling and high cohesion are the classic design goals.

defCn: 内聚，一个模块内部各元素围绕单一职责的紧密程度
defEn: How closely the responsibilities inside a module relate to a single purpose.
codeExample: // a class that both parses JSON and sends email has low cohesion
exampleSentence: High cohesion keeps a class focused on one reason to change.
exampleSentences: High cohesion keeps a class focused on one reason to change.
Splitting a low-cohesion service usually reveals a cleaner boundary.

defCn: 单例模式，保证一个类只有一个实例并提供全局访问点的设计模式
defEn: A design pattern ensuring a class has only one instance with a global access point.
codeExample: public static Singleton getInstance() { return INSTANCE; }
exampleSentence: The singleton pattern is convenient but makes unit testing harder.
exampleSentences: The singleton pattern is convenient but makes unit testing harder.
An enum is often the safest way to implement a singleton in Java.

defCn: 工厂模式，把对象创建逻辑集中到工厂，调用方无需关心具体类型
defEn: A creational pattern that centralizes object creation so callers need not know concrete types.
exampleSentence: A factory pattern removes the giant switch statement from the service layer.
exampleSentences: A factory pattern removes the giant switch statement from the service layer.

defCn: 策略模式，把可互换的算法封装成独立对象，运行时自由切换
defEn: A behavioral pattern that encapsulates interchangeable algorithms switchable at runtime.
exampleSentence: The strategy pattern let us swap pricing rules without touching the caller.
exampleSentences: The strategy pattern let us swap pricing rules without touching the caller.

defCn: 观察者模式，主题状态变化时自动通知所有订阅者
defEn: A pattern where subjects automatically notify all subscribed observers when state changes.
exampleSentence: Event listeners are a common implementation of the observer pattern.
exampleSentences: Event listeners are a common implementation of the observer pattern.

defCn: 依赖注入，由外部容器把依赖传入对象，而非对象自己创建依赖
defEn: Supplying an object's dependencies from outside rather than having it construct them.
exampleSentence: Dependency injection makes the class testable with a fake repository.
exampleSentences: Dependency injection makes the class testable with a fake repository.
Constructor injection is preferred over field injection in Spring.

defCn: 控制反转，把流程控制权从应用代码交给框架或容器
defEn: Handing control of program flow from application code to a framework or container.
codeExample: // the container calls your @PostConstruct, not the reverse
exampleSentence: Inversion of control is why Spring can manage your bean lifecycle.
exampleSentences: Inversion of control is why Spring can manage your bean lifecycle.

defCn: 副作用，函数除了返回值之外对外部状态产生的改变
defEn: Any change to external state a function makes beyond returning a value.
codeExample: // mutating a static field is a side effect
exampleSentence: Pure functions have no side effect, which makes them trivial to test.
exampleSentences: Pure functions have no side effect, which makes them trivial to test.
Stream operations should avoid side effects because order is not guaranteed.

defCn: 饥饿，某些线程长期得不到所需资源而始终无法执行
defEn: A situation where a thread is perpetually denied the resources it needs to run.
codeExample: // an unfair lock can starve waiting threads
